CheckTitle: Ensure IAM inline policies that allow full '*:*' administrative privileges are not associated to IAM identities
CheckType: Software and Configuration Checks/Industry and Regulatory Standards/CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark
Software and Configuration Checks/AWS Security Best Practices/Identity and Access Management
Description: Checks whether inline policies on users, groups or roles grant full administrative privileges.
Risk: Inline *:* policies are hard to audit and grant unrestricted control of the account to the embedding identity.

Recommendation.Text: Remove inline administrative policies and use reviewed, least-privileged managed policies instead.
